description_en: Modifies the configurations of an Express Connect circuit
description_zh: 调用ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute接口修改物理专线的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-physical-connection-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The carrier that provides the access to the physical line. Valid values:

CT: China Telecom
CU: China Unicom
CM: China Mobile
CO: Other carriers in the Chinese mainland
Equinix: Equinix
Other: Other carriers outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
提供接入物理线路的运营商，取值： 
             
CT：中国电信   

CU：中国联通   

CM：中国移动   

CO：中国其他   

Equinix：Equinix   

Other：境外其他
parameters.name: line_operator

parameters.help_en: The bandwidth of the Express Connect circuit access interface. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 2 to 10240
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线接入接口带宽，单位Mbps，取值范围：2~10240
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.example: 浙江省杭州市XX区XX街道XX号
parameters.help_en: The geographic location of the on-premises data center
parameters.help_zh: 本地数据中心的地理位置。
parameters.name: peer_location

parameters.help_en:
The port type of the Express Connect circuit access point. Valid values:

100Base-T: 100M Ethernet port.
1000Base-T (default): 1 GE electrical port.
1000Base-LX: GE single-mode optical port (10 km).
10GBase-T: 10 GE electrical port.
10GBase-LR: 10 GE single-mode optical port (10 km).
40GBase-LR: 40 GE single-mode optical port.
100GBase-LR: 100 GE single-mode optical port.

40GBase-LR and 100GBase-LR are subject to the availability of backend port resources. Contact your account manager for more information
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线接入端口类型，取值： 
             
100Base-T：百兆电口。 

1000Base-T（默认值）：千兆电口。   

1000Base-LX：千兆单模光口（10千米）。   

10GBase-T：万兆电口 。  

10GBase-LR：万兆单模光口（10千米） 。  

40GBase-LR：四万兆单模光口。   

100GBase-LR：十万兆单模光口。   

40GBase-LR和100GBase-LR需要根据实际后台端口水位情况进行创建，具体水位情况请联系商务经理。
parameters.name: port_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the redundant Express Connect circuit. The redundant circuit must be in the Allocated, Confirmed, or Enabled state
parameters.help_zh: 冗余物理专线的ID，该专线的状态必须为Allocated、Confirmed或Enabled
parameters.name: redundant_physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Express Connect circuit.  

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线的描述信息。  

长度为 2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Express Connect circuit.  

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线的名称。  

长度为 2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，半角句号（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The circuit code provided by the carrier for the Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh: 运营商为物理专线提供的电路编码
parameters.name: circuit_code

parameters.help_en: The port down delay time of the Express Connect circuit, in milliseconds. When a physical link Down event is detected, the access device waits for this duration before setting the port to the down state. This prevents transient disconnections from affecting your services. Valid values: 0 to 10000. The step size is 100. A value of 0 indicates that the port goes down immediately after the link goes down (default)
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线端口下线延迟时间，单位为毫秒。当检测到物理链路 Down 事件时，接入设备等待该时长后再将端口置为下线，用于避免链路闪断对业务造成影响。取值范围：0~10000，步长为 100。取值为 0 表示端口 Down 后立即下线（默认）
parameters.name: down_delay_time
